scope: CUBE-REV research/version branches descended from this research lineage; does not mutate public runner, collector, or human-launch authority.

passive_default.napkin: ON — preserve scientific intent, frozen estimands, falsifiers, and prohibited claims; any post-outcome representation change is a new remand/version, never an in-place rewrite.
passive_default.ravel: ON — repeated design/implementation/adversarial/statistical/authority loops; operational failure and negative scientific result are always separated.
passive_default.court: ON when a claim crosses a gate.
passive_default.trace: ON for run IDs, hashes, inputs, execution facts, and failures.
passive_default.atlas: ON for version lineage and supersession.
passive_default.sentinel: ON before persistent or consequential writes; research branches have no implicit main/public/human authority.
passive_default.steward: ON for fail-observable checkpoints and resumable execution.
passive_default.forge_prism_orbit_axiom_scout_pivot: Conditional — invoked when implementation, uncertainty decomposition, state transition, invariant proof, external evidence, or representation remand materially improves rigor.

standing_invariants: Do not optimize the research definition to obtain positive results.
Do not reinterpret a posthoc sensitivity as a prospective primary result.
Do not lower coverage, ESS, overlap, or integrity gates after outcome inspection.
Do not infer cognitive intention, error, or recovery from algebraic/state geometry alone without an explicit identification bridge.
Keep negative results, measurement failures, selection failures, and implementation failures as distinct states.
Human recruitment remains disabled until a future version explicitly passes its human-launch gate.
Main/public/collector changes require separate authority and are never inherited from a research PASS.
inheritance_rule: A later CUBE-REV research version may add stricter local gates. It may not silently weaken these defaults. Any deliberate override must be explicit, versioned, justified, and recorded before affected outcomes are inspected.
